items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Well we made the band together... Sam Robinson and Johnny Deale.

ctx.x: Well we made the band together. Oh I see. See we made the band together. Was me uh.
Morgan. Lil Jim. Johnny Dave. And uh. My brother Sam. Sam Robertson. And Johnny Dave. Sam Robinson and Johnny Deale.
Only one saxophone and clarinet play.
